text: Atmospheric storage tanks for LDO and fire water shall comply with API 650 (fixed cone roof; internal floating roof not required for LDO with the flash point of DP-EPCE-0013), with foundation ring wall and leak detection under the bottom. Tank bottoms shall have a slope and a sump for water draw-off. Tanks handling flammable liquids shall be designed with NFPA 30 spacing, venting and bund requirements. Shop-built tanks of demineralised water and chemicals shall comply with EN 14015 or the package standard (API 650 for steel tanks above 10 m3 in flammable service).
